rationale: False alarm from a bad source-count anchor. The extracted current-quarter position sum is $29,530.8 million, which closely agrees with the filing's current-period fair-value total of $29,499.3 million (difference $31.5 million, about 0.11%). The filing separately presents a comparative-period investment schedule totaling $29,484.8 million, demonstrating that raw schedule rows and facts span more than the current-period position population. Therefore 4,858 raw source items is not a valid one-to-one expected position count, and the 1,421 output count does not establish missing data.
